bus_sgd_per_bus_km.note: Full resource cost per scheduled revenue bus-km, 2026 SGD excl. GST = BCM operator fee + LTA bus capital + LTA depot capital. Operator fee (contract value, LTA tender prices / scheduled bus-km from LTA published headways x 350 days, CPI to 2026): low 4.63 (Sembawang-Yishun 2020 bid, 365 days), central 5.24 (Seletar 2024 award, the package of the Yishun feeders), high 6.05 (Tampines 2025 award, 335 days). Fee includes bus captains and staff, bus maintenance, fuel (indexed), depot and interchange O&M, overheads, margin, pre-operation costs and an undisclosed lease charge for LTA assets; excludes indexation after the bid, incentives, service variations. Bus capital: e-bus prices 2025 (SD 425k, blend 487k, DD 580k, 2026 SGD), 17-yr statutory life, residual 0, r = 2 / 3.5 / 7 %, 75.0k / 53.0k / 43.7k km per bus-year -> 0.40 / 0.73 / 1.36 per km. Depot capital: LTA multi-storey depot contracts 585k / 696k / 786k per bus space (2026 SGD), life 50 / 40 / 30 yrs -> 0.25 / 0.62 / 1.45 per km. Land, fare/fleet systems (~0.1/km) and LTA overheads excluded. Use the operator-fee-only values (4.6 / 5.2 / 6.0) for a 'payments by LTA' view; they may also avoid double counting if the lease charge recovers asset depreciation. Apply either per bus-km or per bus-hour, never both. low_cost here is the low cost value; note that for B(ii) a low bus cost means a SMALLER avoidable saving.

bus_sgd_per_bus_hour.unit: SGD per bus-hour (model bus-hours: running + dwell)
bus_sgd_per_bus_hour.note: bus_sgd_per_bus_km x 13.89 km/h (in-area mix: 33,871 bus-km / 2,439 bus-hours per weekday). Restatement of the per-km value at the in-area speed mix; no package bus-hours are published. Do not apply together with bus_sgd_per_bus_km.

onboard_staff_sgd_per_hour.unit: SGD per staff-hour (fully loaded employer cost per worked hour)
onboard_staff_sgd_per_hour.note: MOM OWS June 2025, bus driver (SSOC 83311), Transportation & Storage: gross P25 / median / P75 = 2,700 / 3,919 / 4,881 SGD per month. Loaded: (12 x gross + 1 month basic bonus) x (1 + 17 % employer CPF + 5 % on-costs) + SDL, / 2,179 worked h per FTE-year (46.5 paid h/week, 29 days leave), x CPI 1.0151. high_cost includes an assumed 1.15 supervision factor. Cross-checks: Grab AV safety operator advert 3,500-4,000/month; LTA: bus captain pay > 4,000/month incl. bonuses from 2027. Residents only (no foreign-worker levy case).

remote_operator_sgd_per_hour.note: MOM OWS June 2025, road transport operations officer (SSOC 31597), T&S: gross 3,068 / 3,825 / 4,625. Same loading as onboard staff. No MOM occupation exists for AV remote operators; a scarce specialised role may cost more (high_cost = P75 x 1.15).

field_staff_sgd_per_hour.note: MOM OWS June 2025, automotive engineering technician (SSOC 31212), T&S: gross 2,920 / 3,684 / 4,177. Same loading. A higher-skill EV technician (mechanical engineering technician 31151, median 4,546) gives 33.3 central.

cleaning_sgd_per_vehicle_day.note: minutes/60 x cleaner loaded hourly + consumables. Cleaner hourly 15.1 / 15.9 / 30.8 SGD (PWM 1 Jul 2026 indoor cleaner basic 2,080; high = MOM motor vehicle cleaner/polisher median gross 3,660). Minutes per vehicle-day 8-12-18 / 12-20-30 / 20-30-45 (4/10/20 seats) and consumables 0.5 / 1.0 / 2.0 are assumptions (no source). Relation to the AV researcher (proposed_av.json, cleaning_sgd_per_vehicle_day 10-seat 4.25 / 11.9 / 25.0): the hourly rates agree (theirs ~S$17/h incl. a 1.2 contractor margin, mine 15.9 in-house); theirs is higher mainly because it allows 30-45 min per vehicle-day for in-day checks of an unattended vehicle (Ongel et al.: 15 min/day for a 12 m bus). Mine covers routine daily cleaning only: use it where in-day checks are done by field staff or onboard staff; use the AV figure (or add the difference) for unattended operation.

electricity_sgd_per_kwh.unit: SGD per kWh drawn from the grid
electricity_sgd_per_kwh.note: central: SP Group low-tension tariff, mean of the four 2026 quarters (26.71, 27.27, 31.91, 28.59 c/kWh, before GST). low: high-tension small supply, overnight off-peak charging (15.71 c/kWh + capacity charge 14.64 $/kW/month at 8 h/night = 21.7). high: HT daytime peak charging at 20 % load factor (25.95 + 10.0 = 36.0). GST (9 %) excluded. Public DC fast charging (0.69-0.82 excl. GST) is an upper reference only and already contains charger capital.

discount_rate_real.note: No published Singapore MOF/LTA social discount rate. central: UK Green Book STPR 3.5 % (Feb 2026; an independent June 2026 review recommends 3.0 %), inside the Singapore market-implied 2.5-4 % (Fesselmeyer, Liu & Salvo 2021). low: 2 % (Singapore real government borrowing cost < 1 %; US A-4 2023). high: 7 % (US OMB A-4 2003 opportunity cost of capital). ADB 9 % (developing countries) not used. The bus asset add-on uses the same three rates.

vot_ivt_sgd_per_hour.note: SOCIAL VALUE, kept separate from operator cost; low_cost = low value. central: LTA-commissioned 2015 stated-choice study (Hess et al. 2017, TRR 2664) equity value of travel time 16.39 SGD/h (2015) x CPI 1.2044. low: bus users' own crowding-weighted in-vehicle value 11.73 c/min = 7.04 SGD/h (2015) x 1.2044. high: equity value x median income growth 2015-2025 (5,775/3,949) x 1.0151. A revealed-preference smart-card estimate (~S$2/h, Agarwal et al. 2020) is an outlier, not used.

wait_time_weight.note: SOCIAL VALUE; low_cost = low value. low: Singapore bus users 2015 (waiting 15.06 / in-vehicle 11.73 c/min = 1.28). central: Wardman et al. 2026 worldwide meta-analysis (1.50 SP emphasis, 1.75 RP emphasis). high: 2.0, the long-standing convention inside UK TAG M3.2's 1.5-2.5. Applies to mean wait; excess (unreliable) wait is valued far higher in Singapore (6.1 x bus IVT) but is not separated in the model.

attendant_sgd_per_hour.unit: SGD per staff-hour (fully loaded employer cost per worked hour)
attendant_sgd_per_hour.note: Onboard customer service officer / attendant (LTA's stated next phase: remote operator + onboard customer service officer). central: MOM OWS June 2025 rail station service assistant (SSOC 51121), Transportation & Storage, median gross 3,588 (frontline public-transport customer service on shifts). low: customer service officer/clerk (SSOC 42245, T&S) P25 gross 2,400. high: customer service officer/clerk P75 3,933 x 1.15 supervision factor. Same loading as the other staff (1 month bonus, 17 % CPF, 5 % on-costs, SDL, 2,179 worked h/yr, CPI 1.0151). A basic vehicle attendant (SSOC 93335, median gross 2,200) would cost 16.2.

depot_sgd_per_vehicle_year.note: = m2 per vehicle x rent per m2-year. m2 (assumption, AV researcher's depot_m2_per_vehicle from LTA's parking code + 25 % / 50 %): 19-24-30 / 36-45-54 / 58-72-87 for 4 / 10 / 20 seats (low / central / high). Rent: low 39.8 SGD/m2-yr (open heavy-vehicle season lot, URA S$130/month incl. GST per 36 m2); central 273.8 (multiple-user factory 1st storey S$2.12 psf/month, Q2 2026, JTC data via OrangeTee); high 564 (LTA purpose-built multi-storey bus depot, 696k per 57.8 m2 bus space, CRF 3.5 %/40 yr). Excludes chargers (charger_sgd_each), site staff and O&M (depot_fixed_sgd_per_year), GST.

depot_fixed_sgd_per_year.unit: SGD per year per depot site
depot_fixed_sgd_per_year.note: Site costs: 24/7 security (1 / 1 / 2 posts x 8,760 h at 19.6 / 22.9 / 25.7 SGD/h, MOM OWS security officer), depot manager (0.5 / 1 / 1 FTE, MOM OWS transport operations manager 73k / 101k / 146k per yr), facility O&M and non-charging utilities 50k / 100k / 250k (assumption). Per site: a fleet of ~450 10-seat vehicles needs ~2 ha and may need two sites (double).
